name: Chokai Quasi-National Park
description: Quasi-national park of Mt. Chokai, the sacred 'Dewa Fuji' on the Yamagata-Akita border, with its shrine, alpine flowers and the plains of the Shonai coast.
notes: Managed by Yamagata. The mountain and the Kisakata coast are the park's two faces.
parking: Parking available at major visitor areas (fee varies)

ja.name: 鳥海国定公園
ja.description: 山形・秋田県境にそびえる霊峰「出羽富士」鳥海山の国定公園。神社、高山植物、庄内平野が特徴です。
ja.notes: 山形県が管理。鳥海山と象潟海岸が公園の二つの顔です。
